other_conditions: Applicant must be an Indian citizen
Applicant must hold a regular academic or research position in a recognized academic institution, national laboratory or other recognized R&D institution in India

Applicants from IITs, IISERs, IISc, NITs, Central Universities and National Labs of Central Government Institutions are eligible under Level I; applicants from State Universities/Colleges and Private Academic Institutions are eligible under Level II
Faculties recruited through the UGC‑Faculty Recharge Program are eligible
INSPIRE Faculty, Ramanujan Fellows and Ramalingaswamy Fellows are eligible provided they have at least three and a half years of tenure remaining at the time of application
A female Co‑Principal Investigator from the same institute is mandatory; male Co‑PI is not allowed
The PhD guide cannot be a Co‑PI
A PI who has already received a POWER Grant is not eligible to apply again
JC Bose fellows and PIs who have already completed two CRG are not eligible
The number of Co‑PIs must not exceed two per project
Women scientists cannot hold a POWER Fellowship and a POWER Grant simultaneously
benefits_summary: Funding up to ₹60 lakhs for three years (Level I) or up to ₹30 lakhs for three years (Level II) covering equipment, manpower, consumables, travel, contingency and overheads.
